cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Every Glitch Is a Gift
cards.instruction: Turn every contradiction or failure into a surprising benefit of the impossible system.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The garden door opens into the broom cupboard. Excellent, we can collect a brush for the picnic crumbs. Pass it handle first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the attic. I've got both hands full of sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold those. Fetch the blanket, folded rather than dragged. This door has saved you the stairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Now it's the cellar, and the sandwiches are getting warm.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Perfect refrigeration. Put them beside the wine, lids closed please. We'll use the door's catering service before we find the garden.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3 fetching correction and A5 food handling turn wrong destinations into benefits under expert management.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 full hands causes A3 to take the sandwiches, but A5 tells B to put them down without returning them.

relationship.evidence: B2 carrying load and B4 temperature concern are useful practical contributions.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 cellar and warmth as refrigeration, but overlooks who currently holds the food.

specificity.evidence: A1 picnic goal is clear; B2 sandwiches alone do not establish the lids invoked in A5.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 catering summary adds a flourish, but the ownership and container wording need precision.

coach2.inferred: Ordinary sandwich containers are plausible but should be named when their lids become an instruction.
coach2.missing: The handoff back to B is unstated and unnecessary.
coach2.firstDefect: A5 loses the current food holder.
